djinn_weapon.act.spirit_sever.desc: The Severing Funeral Scythe: a wide pale cut that leaves no wound and no blood. The spirit of every foe in front of you is cut loose, and what it struck goes numb and limp dead weight for 8 to 20 seconds (Slowness, Weakness, no normal healing; never on a boss). Armour, resistance and shields do not count; a boss loses only a sliver, and no target takes more than a set share per second.
djinn_weapon.act.belior_zakera.desc: Memory Manipulation (sprint + right-click): up to six foes in front of you forget the fight. Mobs lose their target and may turn on each other; players get distorted senses (Nausea and Darkness). Reach 10 blocks in a Half Equip, 24 in a Full Equip. A raised shield or a barrier blocks it, but the defender still takes a small mental strain and a short Nausea and Darkness. A boss is never mind-controlled.
tooltip.anime_multiverse.djinn_weapon.ac: Sprint + right-click: %s (%s%% of your Magoi, %s s)
belial.chant.zauto: Spirit of Truth and Judgement — Assemble your power and bring to the earth the nothingness to judge everything!
belial.lore: Belial, the 68th of the 72 Djinn, Djinn of Truth and Conviction (Shinjitsu / Danzai), of the 8th Type: Life Magic. His first owner is Hakuryuu Ren; his Metal Vessel is the left shoulder armor with Belial's eight-pointed star, and his Household Vessel was wielded by Seiryuu Ri. Belial can change size freely and, being Life Magic like Zagan, can be Dual-Equipped with Zagan without switching forms. Djinn Form: five eyes, gold jewelry, dragon bones on the upper arms and in the swept-back hair. Full Equip: long white-silver hair, two more eyes on the forehead, four arms, jagged black wings and a spectral skeletal dragon that lunges to grab, crush and restrain.
